content: User asks to redesign Migas Amigas site from attached sketch, edit the active Penpot file, then implement semantic HTML/CSS.

Implemented responsive three-column layout and semantic left/right asides in index.html, css/index.css, and css/aside.css. Left links jump to product sections; contact details use mailto/tel; right aside includes language controls and assets/pan/pan-con-masa-madre.jpg as image placeholder. Browser check at 1656px: layout columns, image loaded, no console errors; git diff --check clean.

Penpot edit remains blocked despite user's UI showing MCP connected: penpot.execute_code returns typeof penpot and typeof penpotUtils as undefined. Need reconnect Penpot MCP plugin/project context to this OpenCode session, then inspect pages and create design.
